In detail

Campo di Marte (stadium/station area) was specifically named by FirenzeToday as having become a 'zona rossa' and is described as the only Florence district where reported crime is actually increasing, per the Il Sole 24 Ore crime index. Local press and a councillor's public statement document recurring nighttime break-ins ('spaccate'), organised drug-dealing groups near the stadium, and a resident mobilisation against gang activity and degrado in the neighbourhood. Sources checked: FirenzeToday, 'Sicurezza, Campo di Marte diventa zona rossa: unico quartiere dove i reati aumentano'; Controradio, Il Sole 24 Ore crime index noting Campo di Marte in difficulty; 055firenze.it, break-ins at Campo di Marte; OkFirenze, residents mobilise against drug dealing and gangs at Campo di Marte; Comune di Firenze, Italia Viva councillor statement on Coverciano/Campo di Marte security.
